visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair, wearing a green tracksuit numbered 456, enters a bright pink, geometric studio set resembling stylized staircases. He looks shocked, mouth open, gesturing with his hands. (2) Scene shifts to a blue room with white stars on the ceiling and walls. The man 456 is running frantically across a sandy floor. To his left and right are doors with red indicator lights. (3) He encounters a woman with a visibly pregnant belly (labeled 222) and another woman with long straight hair (labeled 120), both in matching green tracksuits. They stand close together, looking towards a dark doorway. (4) A close-up of a woman with short hair and a green tracksuit (labeled 044) talking confidently. Behind her are large screens displaying various crowded indoor locations like restaurants and offices. (5) A montage of different characters: a man (125) with a smirk, and a man (069) waving in a blue-lit tunnel-like set. (6) Back in the starry room, the characters group together and point towards a digital display of a 'Smoking Area' bus stop. They appear to be breaking character, laughing together. (7) A man numbered 230 tries to run through a closing door but is stopped. He falls to the ground, holding an e-cigarette device. He lies motionless as if defeated. (8) The group of three (456, 222, 120) celebrate by bumping fists. Man 230 is shown again on the floor, then visually disintegrates into green pixels and glass shards. (9) The setting transitions to a formal studio with a pink background and studio lighting. The characters 456, 120, and 222 stand in a line, looking directly at the camera and speaking. A hotline number '0800-636-363' appears at the bottom. (10) The final scene shows the characters laughing and interacting informally as a government logo and health warning text overlay the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A man speaks rapidly in a high-arousal, comedic tone over an electronic beat with a fast tempo (approx 128 BPM). A metallic 'whoosh' transition sound occurs. (2) A robotic, processed voice provides instructions in a mixed dialect. Sharp 'thud' sound effects match visual character movements. (3) Female characters speak with high arousal and urgency. BGM swells into a tense, percussive cinematic sequence. SFX of heavy running footsteps and sliding doors are prominent. (4) Sound of multiple voices laughing together (crowd reaction). BGM shifts to a more playful, meme-like rhythm. (5) A dramatic digital countdown sequence featuring a deep-voiced countdown and a digital UI 'ping' for each second. (6) A sharp, pixelated 'shatter' explosion sound effect accompanies the visual elimination. (7) Final transition to clear, studio-recorded voices speaking calmly and articulately. BGM changes to a soft, uplifting synthesizer melody to support the formal PSA message.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Parody Plot -> Conflict/Resolution -> PSA Infographic -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To raise awareness about the prohibition of e-cigarettes and public smoking regulations in Taiwan through a popular culture parody (Squid Game). It uses humor and high-energy storytelling to capture attention before delivering a formal health and legal warning.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presence of the Ministry of Health and Welfare logo and a quit smoking hotline number.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A creative public service announcement leveraging current media trends to engage a younger audience on legal matters.
